# Fictional reading packet

The entries below are synthetic documents for local testing. example.org addresses are supplied fixture identifiers, not real published papers.

## S1
Title: Compact Text Ranking
Authors: Mina Lee; Joon Park
Year: 2024
Version: 1
Original URL: https://example.org/papers/compact-text-v1
Available text: abstract and Section 2 excerpt.
Abstract: The system scores short documents using their text. The encoder and scoring head are trained with relevance labels.
Section 2: At inference, only document text enters the scoring function. The evaluation uses the Archive-A short-document split.

## S2
Title: Date-Aware Document Ranking
Authors: Mina Lee; Joon Park
Year: 2024
Version: 2
Original URL: https://example.org/papers/date-aware-v2
Available text: abstract, Section 3 excerpt, and bibliography excerpt.
Abstract: We combine document text and publication date in a learned scorer. We report ranking on the News-B collection.
Section 3: Publication date is concatenated to the text representation before scoring. Labels and splits come from News-B. No experiment on Archive-A is reported in this extract.
Bibliography [4]: Lee, Mina, and Park, Joon. Compact Text Ranking. 2024. Version 1.

## S3
Title: Ranking in the Archive
Authors: Mina Lee
Year: 2025
Available text: abstract only, copied from a supplied local note.
Abstract: We describe a document ranking system deployed in an archive.
